titleFormatted.en: Start monitoring device [[device]], name [[name]], continuity [[continuity_minutes]] min, min. confirmation [[min_confirmation_seconds]] s

hint.en: For an on/off-only device (a pump, a device with no reliable standby signal) — creates the monitor on first run if it doesn't exist yet, then starts it, in one step. Meant to be driven by a native "Power becomes greater than X" trigger (or any other Flow logic) instead of this app's own threshold engine. The resulting monitor never decides active/standby on its own — only this card and "Stop monitoring device" do.
